adopted_normative.matching: Exact named key and exact resolved modifier set; extra modifiers prevent matching. Dispatch only on an actual down edge, never text characters/modifier changes/held repeat. No heuristic stripping.
adopted_normative.parser: Trim outer ASCII whitespace. Case-insensitive aliases Control->Ctrl, Cmd/Command/Meta->Super, CtrlOrCmd->Primary, letter names->A..Z; closed key tokens are case-insensitive. resource_contract.rule: A documented conservative logical native working estimate, not process RSS. Every addition/multiplication/count conversion checked before allocation. Validate dimensions, area kind, packed lengths/tail bits, depth, row_count/index and metadata cardinalities before cloning/callbacks. No plane/strip/window acquisition at any phase.

adopted_normative.canonical_grammar: ASCII one named nonmodifier key, zero or more distinct modifiers, '+' separators. Canonical order Primary,Ctrl,Alt,Shift,Super,key; no whitespace. Primary cannot coexist with Ctrl/Super. Explicit Ctrl+Super may parse but must pass all platform policies. No modifier-only/mouse/wheel/scan-code/multi-stroke/arbitrary Unicode binding.
adopted_normative.layout_limit: Backend/ImGui named-key identity is distinct from a physical US key or emitted text. Punctuation/dead keys/AltGr/IME/layout differences need real OS proof, not simulated platform enums.
adopted_normative.matching: Exact named key and exact resolved modifier set; extra modifiers prevent matching. Dispatch only on an actual down edge, never text characters/modifier changes/held repeat. No heuristic stripping.
adopted_normative.parser: Trim outer ASCII whitespace. Case-insensitive aliases Control->Ctrl, Cmd/Command/Meta->Super, CtrlOrCmd->Primary, letter names->A..Z; closed key tokens are case-insensitive. Emit only canonical spellings. Literal '+' is not a key token; Shift+Equal expresses that named-key combination. Reject empty/trailing segments, repeated modifiers, unknown names and non-string inputs.
